criteria.text: Fresh load defaults every non-selected project group collapsed.
The group containing the currently selected session is expanded on load.
Moving selection must not collapse a project group that held a real selected session since load, unless explicitly closed.
An explicit false closes the selected group immediately and remains stored through document remount; the selected group reopens on each mount without rewriting that preference.
Explicit true and false project choices survive browser-process close and relaunch on the same persistent profile.
Explicit per-project state preserves a manually opened non-selected group, while a genuinely created project defaults closed without disturbing it.
Throwing storage reads and writes fall back safely without crashing the rail.
Rendered Lucide right/down chevrons and aria-expanded toggle together.
